CustomField.description: Populated by flow (SurveyResponse_Contact_UpdateMostRecentCSATScoreAndComments) when a Feedback Survey Response record's CSAT Score is created or updated, CSAT Score is stored to this field. Read Only to add by Admins (via profile) and Typeform Integration User that triggers the flow (via permission set)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Customer Satisfaction Score: 1(very dissatisfied) - 5(very satisfied) From the most recently created Feedback Survey Response.
CustomField.label: Most Recent CSAT Score
